correction: Keep v05's Nagoji exactly: pressed flat against the ladder with his cheek on the wood, eyes squeezed shut, face turned away from the fall, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, long curly hair, empty hinged iron collar with side ring, torn ochre sleeveless tunic, cream dhoti, and his left forearm bandaged from wrist to mid-forearm with its inner side against the wood. Also keep the guard seen from behind, face hidden, in morion, buff leather jerkin, cream shirt and cross-belt, arms flung out grasping at nothing, with cold lightning light from above. Fix three things. (1) IRONS: no cuff, shackle or chain touches the ladder. Show BOTH bandaged hands gripping the same flat tread, each in its own manacle, joined only to each other by one short slack chain about a forearm long. His two ankle cuffs are joined only to each other by their own short hobble chain. No chain runs between wrists and ankles, and there are no empty cuffs anywhere. (2) LADDER: make it the steep wooden companion ladder with flat treads and side rails from 6.5, 7.1, 7.3 and 7.4, not round rungs. (3) SETTING: this is INSIDE the ship's hold. Overhead is a closed timber deck with heavy beams, pierced by ONE rectangular hatch just above the ladder, where the lightning and rain show. Everything else around the shaft is the dark hold interior: beams, hull planking, lashed barrels and bales, and a warm hanging-lantern glow deep in the background. Far below, the guard drops toward black flood water covering the hold floor among the barrels at the ladder foot. No open sea, no waves, no horizon, and no sky beyond the one hatch. Silent panel: no text, no balloons, no caption boxes.
issues: v05 gets Nagoji right: cheek pressed to the ladder, eyes squeezed shut, face turned from the fall, thick curled moustache, clean chin, clear gold ear stud, empty hinged collar with side ring, torn ochre tunic, cream dhoti, and a left forearm bandaged from wrist to mid-forearm with its inner side against the wood. The guard also works: seen from behind with his face hidden, morion, buff jerkin, cross-belt, cream sleeves, arms flung out, falling. Three problems rule it out. (1) Irons: an EMPTY iron cuff is clamped round the ladder's side rail. The wrist chain runs from his manacle down to it, and a second chain runs from it to his ankle cuff, so he reads as chained to the ladder, which breaks the escape logic and the bible rig. His second hand is not shown. (2) The ladder has round rungs, unlike the flat-tread companion ladder in 6.5, 7.1 (v12), 7.3 and 7.4. (3) The setting does not read as the ship's hold. It is a bare plank shaft open to the sky across its whole top, with no deck beams, lamps or cargo. At its foot is wave-tossed water fading to a horizon-like haze, so the guard seems to fall off the ship into the open sea. In 7.3 his body lies in the flooded hold. There is no text or gore.

issues: v01 is the pick. It shows Nagoji thrown against the rail, gripping a line, with the rope coil at his bare feet. His face is on-model: curled moustache, clean chin, gold stud. His collar ring is empty, and the hobble chain is clear. The mast is snapped and leaning with torn canvas. There is a sailor with a knife in his teeth, men at the pump handles, a mixed barefoot crew, and nobody looking at him. The black-and-gold carved stern is close to the Chapter 2 ship. The painted boxes sit over sky at top left and top right. Minor faults in v01: there seem to be two cuffs on his right wrist, and the wrist chain hangs from one cuff without visibly joining the other wrist. A tiny gilt scroll band under the stern gallery is faintly letter-like at high zoom but reads as ornament at panel size. v02 to v06 are one image, and it has two problems: its stern castle reads like a lamp-lit palace, and a chain runs from the collar ring (heavy and down to the wrist in v02), which contradicts the 'empty collar'. v07 to v09 show Nagoji standing and hauling rope like a crewman instead of thrown against the rail, and they have no stern castle.
